question: Should OpenClaw adopt public memory role slots such as `memory.recall`, `memory.capture`, `memory.compaction`, `memory.dreaming`, and `memory.userModel`, or keep memory as one exclusive slot while solving coexistence through narrower plugin APIs?
rationale: Current main still has one memory slot, the linked PR changes public config and plugin activation contracts, and VISION.md says memory is single-slot today while inviting plugin API discussions when needed.

options.title: Review role-slot PR
options.body: Use the open implementation PR as the canonical place to decide the public memory role-slot taxonomy, migration behavior, and compatibility proof.

options.title: Narrow to plugin APIs
options.body: Keep this issue open but redirect the fix toward smaller plugin API or dreaming coexistence seams without adding multiple public slot keys.

options.title: Decline multi-slot direction
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR if maintainers decide memory should converge on one recommended default path instead of public role slots.

recommendation.title: Review role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Use the open implementation PR as the canonical place to decide the public memory role-slot taxonomy, migration behavior, and compatibility proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the adjacent multi-kind slot architecture PR and are the best available current-main routing candidate from the inspected history.
